description: This file defines the interface IStateMachineLogWriter, which provides methods for writing log entries to a state machine within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for appending individual and multiple log entries, parameterized by state, using delegates.

classes.name: IStateMachineLogWriter
classes.description: An interface for writing out-of-band log entries for a state machine in Orleans, with methods for appending log entries.

methods.name: AppendEntry
methods.description: Appends a single log entry to the state machine log, invoking a delegate to generate the log data.

parameters.action: A delegate that takes the state and a buffer writer to create the log entry
parameters.state: The state to pass to the delegate

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends multiple log entries to the state machine log, invoking a delegate with the state and a storage writer.

parameters.action: A delegate that takes the state and a storage writer to create log entries
parameters.state: The state to pass to the delegate
